---
name: Bug report
about: Something produced a wrong result, crashed or hung
labels: bug
---

**What did you analyze?** (repo, `.pyc`, Docker image; size; Python version it was built with)

**What happened?** (include the error message, or the line of the report that is wrong)

**What did you expect?**

**Environment** (Python version, OS, agent, whether Docker was used)

Please do **not** attach artifacts that contain secrets or code you may not share. A minimal synthetic reproduction is ideal.
